proposed_widenings.name: grant_extra_turn
proposed_widenings.justification: The feature grants a second full combat turn at a specific initiative offset (Initiative - 10), scoped to the first round only. This is mechanically distinct from grant_extra_action (which adds one of the 12 standard actions within an existing turn). No existing v4 atom covers multi-turn allocation within a single round or initiative-offset-based turn scheduling.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take two turns during the first round of any combat. You take your first turn at your normal Initiative and your second turn at your Initiative minus 10.

notes: The passive family is the correct container (always-on, no resource, no activation cost). The gap is purely at the effect-atom level: grant_extra_action captures an extra action quota within a turn, not a second full turn at a different initiative count. The first-round-only scope and the -10 initiative offset are both novel parameters with no existing surface encoding. No honest dhall encoding is possible without the new atom.
